answer.explanation: The live configuration of CompressionFunction sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', while the IaC template intends it to reference the OutputBucket resource (lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi). The function was last modified at 00:50:44Z, and from 00:50:48Z onward every invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET. The IaC template has no matching change, and the IAM role is unaffected, so the cause is the live environment variable and not IAM or code.
